question: By whom and by what means is the yoginī named Wish said to extend up to the end of Māyā?
premises: The yoginī named Wish is the subject.
She is associated with the siddhas.
She extends up to the end of Māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Wish, by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā in relation to the siddhas.
uncertainties: The precise relation between the yoginī and the siddhas is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The yoginī named Wish, by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā by the siddhas.
